title: The Loudest Quiet
caption: THE OBSERVER WORLD — Chapter II FINALE, Episode 8: The Loudest Quiet. He came back, and he had learned them all — every way they knew how to stand together, he sang each one back. So the Keeper looked at the empty place beside him, said listen, and played nothing. He could copy any sound; so they gave him none. Silence is not the end of music. It is written into it. It is a rest. And in the quiet, the Keeper understood: a keeper is one who gives his own away. He had taken everything, and no one had ever given him anything. So the Keeper held out his own note — the one the Elder gave him — and the hole closed. The ones he had taken came back. All but one. The world had its song back, and the Keeper had empty hands. Which is how you know he was a keeper. — end of Chapter II —  the more you know, the more you observe.  #theobserver #animation #ambient #music #storytelling
